text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They call her the "Wicked Witch of the
Lab".

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Day and night, she runs amok through the
academy, hunting down students.
Those who get caught are dragged to
another world to be
experimented on.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
More and more students are growing
worried, so
I'd like to get to the bottom
of all this somehow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This strange rumor has spread unrest
throughout the academy, and a
concerned Tazuna has come
to me for
help. As I set out to investigate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud, thud, thud, thud!

You there! Would you mind stopping my
advance?
Oh, I suppose you can't! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch,
she's unbelievably fast! It doesn't
match up
with my data at all!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... Do you know which direction...
Tachyon
headed?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It seems she experimented on
herself...
again...
choice_data_list: Was that Agnes Tachyon just now!?
Was that Agnes Tachyon just now!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this isn't the time for chitchat. I'm
going
after her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to expose the truth behind that
rumor, I
join the pursuit of Agnes
Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: There she is!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's dangerous... so you should stand
back... and
watch...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We chase after a loudly cackling Agnes
Tachyon as she dashes through the
academy. For some reason, each of her
strides looks unusually
smooth...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Damn it, you're really giving us a hard time...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Aha... hahaha! I've fina—cough, cough! finally managed to stop myself!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was testing out a new
experimental
device, as per usual.
However...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, it seems I selected the right shape
for these
knee braces. They fit well, and
they don't impede
my range of motion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I should go for a test run right
a—hmmm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Once I start running in these braces, I
can neither stop nor control my
destination. And thus, I've
been running
continuously for the past few days.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But during our little game of tag, the
power
seems to have finally petered out.
Haha, I
couldn't be more grateful!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is no laughing matter... Tachyon, are
you
feeling okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But why even make that device in the
first place?
Not like you can use it in a
race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, even I wanted to experience a
dream made
reality at least once.

text_block_list.name: Shakur and Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
...You what?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Put simply, I hypothesized that factors
such as dreams and aspirations contain
the power to
surpass the boundaries of
Umamusume-kind.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The urge to catch up to a rival—to reach
the top. Just think about how many
Umamusume have
been fueled by such
egotistical desires!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, as I tried to motivate myself, I
realized
that I didn't have the dreams
and aspirations
others speak of.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to better understand this
impetus, and thus I thought the quickest
way was to simulate
the experience of
achieving one's dream!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So you... wanted to feel the power of
dreams.
That makes sense... at least.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To surpass her limits, Agnes Tachyon is
even willing to experiment on herself.
She may not realize it, but she already
harbors powerful
ambitions.
choice_data_list: In that case, you didn't need that...
In that case, you didn't even need...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I would argue that my ambitions
fall under a very different category of
desire compared to the
dreams of other
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's this?
I'm feeling a little faint...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch. That's what you get for running
around nonstop on an empty stomach.
Quit it with these
strange experiments
already.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't be absurd! My thirst for
knowledge will
never be quenched!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was definitely on the cusp of a major

breakthrough! If I can tweak the power
output
and boot timing, then surely—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You gotta eat before that!
...Ugh,
it's no good. She's in her own little
world.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When she gets like this... there's no
stopping her.
The best we can do... is to
keep watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite their frustrations, the two hold
back from directly intervening. I get the
sense that they
want to support Agnes
Tachyon's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While I was on that exhilarating run, I
came up
with a new idea!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Our delightful game of cat and mouse
was the perfect inspiration for my next
device. Naturally,
I'll require
cooperation from the two of you to—

text_block_list.name: Shakur and Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fat chance.
Not interested...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two are left dumbfounded by Agnes

Tachyon, who clearly hasn't learned her
lesson
from this fiasco.
